🔵⚪️ v 🟢🟢

Sandbach United v Wolverhampton Casuals

Game underway here as The Bach welcome back Mason Wilson into the starting line up after a prolonged absence due to injury and illness.
Sandbach starting line up for todays fixture https://t.co/RACI095B6D

Home game today 3pm kick off against Wolverhampton Casuals - it’s an early season 6 pointer as we take on top of the table!
See you at the game!
JKD and Dec give us their thoughts on tonight’s win in the sunshine, the rain and the night sky in Shropshire with a 3 4 away win at Market Drayton https://t.co/1QAYNhGeua
Kieran O’Connell gives us his run down on his brace of goals in tonight’s 3 4 win at Market Drayton… well done son, don’t shave that moustache off until you get a hat-trick https://t.co/NQj0jEvBzm

🔴⚪️ v 🟡🟡

Market Drayton 3 v Sandbach United 4

It’s an away win for The Bach who worked their socks off after going down to 10 men in the 2nd half and grabbed a winner courtesy of a brace from O’Connell with the second being the decisive 4th and winning goal, 3pts get in!
